# Rain Dust Blog

> Personal blog about coding, technology, experiments, projects, creative ideas, and related technical topics.

Canonical site: https://feenix100.github.io/

## Main

- [Rain Dust Blog home](https://feenix100.github.io/): Homepage and index of recent posts.
- [Contact / About](https://feenix100.github.io/posts/about-me.html): Information about the author and contact details.

## Usage notes

- Prefer the canonical URLs above when citing or linking to this site.
- Individual posts may contain source code, interactive demos, images, and external references.
- The site is intended to be publicly indexable; respect applicable robots directives and normal HTTP access controls.
